solution: Dieu kien xac dinh: x + 2 > 0 va x - 4 > 0, suy ra x > 4.
Phuong trinh tro thanh log_3((x + 2)(x - 4)) = 3, tuc la (x + 2)(x - 4) = 27.
Khai trien: x^2 - 2x - 8 = 27, suy ra x^2 - 2x - 35 = 0, nghiem x = 7 hoac x = -5.
Doi chieu dieu kien x > 4: loai x = -5, giu x = 7.
Phuong trinh chi co mot nghiem thuc x = 7 nen tong cac nghiem la 7.
questions.explanation: Voi x > 4, hai logarit cung co so 3 gop thanh log_3((x + 2)(x - 4)) = 3, dan den x^2 - 2x - 35 = 0. Nghiem x = -5 khong thoa dieu kien x > 4 (x + 2 = -3 < 0 va x - 4 = -9 < 0 nen log_3(x + 2) va log_3(x - 4) khong xac dinh), do do bi loai. Chi con x = 7 nen tong cac nghiem bang 7. Dap an 2 trong ghi chu ra soat chi dung neu bao gom ca nghiem ngoai lai -5 (7 + (-5) = 2), dieu nay sai vi -5 nam ngoai tap xac dinh.

uncertainty.reason: Phuong trinh co dang chuan, tap xac dinh x > 4 loai ro rang nghiem -5.
